scope: Release upgrade evaluation only: isolated loopback instances, two dummy Codex OAuth files, local HTTP/2 TLS CONNECT mock; no installation or production access.
question: Does v8.0.7 fix issue #6247 (9e71c20d), and preserve tested failover/cooldown/affinity behavior versus installed 7.3.11?

conclusion.before_any_sse_bytes: After upstream HTTP 200 headers but before SSE DATA: 7.3.11 returns HTTP 408 invalid_request_error, attempts A only, leaves A eligible; all three fresh-session followups repeat the failure. 8.0.7 returns HTTP 200, response.completed and MOCK_B, attempts A then B; A is unavailable with a 60-second model cooldown (reason unknown). All three fresh-session followups complete on B only.
conclusion.before_upstream_headers: Unchanged: HTTP 200 completion on B after attempts A,B. A remains eligible and all three fresh-session followups retry A,B again.
conclusion.after_generated_delta: Unchanged streaming behavior: HTTP 200, MOCK_A followed by request_timeout/server_error SSE event, no response.completed, no retry on B; A stays eligible and all three followups fail on A. Both versions already use server_error for this SSE error event.
conclusion.http_408_classification_fix_confirmed: Supplemental non-streaming partial-upstream-output disconnect: both versions return HTTP 408 and attempt A only; 7.3.11 body is invalid_request_error, v8.0.7 body is server_error with code request_timeout. A remains eligible in both.
conclusion.both_empty_streams: Supplemental streaming case with A and B disconnecting before SSE bytes: 7.3.11 returns 408 invalid_request_error after A only and leaves both eligible; v8.0.7 attempts A,B, returns HTTP 500 server_error/internal_server_error (not 502), and applies a 60-second model cooldown to both.
conclusion.summary: Fix confirmed for premature disconnect before any SSE payload and HTTP 408 classification. No observed regressions in tested existing behavior; partial-output streaming disconnect retry/cooldown limitations remain.

regressions.unchanged: Streaming/non-streaming quota failover; settled cooldown exclusion; body reset over Retry-After; absolute reset precedence; header-only fallback timing; affinity rebind and retention after clear; both-exhausted local 429 and 10-second floor; priority patch preserves cooldown; explicit reset clears it; before-header failover; partial-output streaming errors.
regressions.intentional_behavior_changes: Empty-stream failures now fail over and cool the failing model for 60 seconds; non-streaming HTTP 408 now uses server_error.
regressions.comparison_notes: Excludes generated mock IDs and timing/timestamp noise only. Error codes/types/messages, attempts, completion, HTTP status and cooldown scope/reason remain compared; raw timestamps and observed 60-second durations remain in runs.

harness_adaptations.description: Version >=8.0.7 expects A,B completion and B-only followups plus 60-second model cooldown for the empty-stream scenario. Older versions retain the original 408/A-only/no-cooldown checks. All other original behavior checks remain; an additional request_timeout/server_error SSE check applies to both versions.
harness_adaptations.initial_8.0.7_probe: Exit 1 against original pre-fix expectations: exactly three empty-stream checks failed; all 31 other original checks passed.
harness_adaptations.corrected_expectation: A trial added invalid_request_error expectation for baseline partial-output SSE events failed; raw results showed server_error already exists there in 7.3.11. Corrected before final full runs.

reproduction.dependency_setup: Download pinned h2 4.3.0, hpack 4.1.0, hyperframe 6.1.0 wheels; verify against PyPI SHA256 metadata, extract only under scratch/v807-test-deps. Dependencies removed after testing; recreate to rerun.
reproduction.minimal_fault: A priority 100, healthy B priority 0. Loopback HTTP/2 mock sends 200 text/event-stream then closes TLS after 0.2 seconds without SSE DATA or END_STREAM.
reproduction.followup_timing: First immediately after initial request; second after up to two seconds polling cooldown state; third immediately after second. All followups use fresh session IDs.
reproduction.parallelism: Final full runs use separate temporary directories, gateway subprocesses and ephemeral loopback ports; harness inputs held stable throughout.
